verdict.line: You lose if you throw E (Test of Spirit) while her Q and E are both up and she dashes or blocks out of it; you win if you wait for her to burn Broken Wings or Valor first and land E the instant they're down.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's entire win condition is landing E (Test of Spirit, range 900); Riven's entire survival tool is her Q (Broken Wings) and E (Valor) mobility, which can only dodge that spirit-link while either is off cooldown. The lane is decided by cooldown tracking, not raw damage trades — which is why the data shows Illaoi holding lane and solo-kill advantage despite a near-even overall win rate.

theirWindow.when: She has both Q and E up
theirWindow.what: She can freely engage with Broken Wings dashes, block your damage with Valor, then Ki Burst (W) stun to punish any trade you start. Don't throw E into this window — she'll just dash or block through it and punish the whiff.

yourWindow.when: Her Q and E are both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: This is the only safe window for E (Test of Spirit) — she has nothing left to gap-close away or block the link with. Land it immediately and follow with W (Harsh Lesson, 4s cooldown) to pull Tentacles onto her for the spirit-echo burst.

Sterak's + tentacle healing win extended skirmishes

start.why: Most-picked start on record (57.9% pick, 54.5% win rate) — the AD and sustain win early poke trades before your E is strong enough to carry the lane.

boots.why: Dominant pick (84.2% pick, 62.5% win rate) — the flat damage reduction blunts her Runic Blade-empowered autos and Ki Burst follow-up poke.

core.why: Armor shred lets your tentacle hits and autos keep scaling through her kit, which has no built-in sustain to out-trade a stacking Cleaver.
Adds an AoE slow on proc right as Tentacles converge on an E-locked target, making it much harder for her to walk the spirit link off.
A health and tenacity spike that outlasts her one real burst window — after her combo is spent she has no follow-up damage to punish you with.

situational.when: she's building pure AD and starting to out-trade you on autos
her Q-into-W burst threatens to kill you before your tentacle healing can catch up
she's rushing early lifesteal or on-hit to poke you down before level 6

runes.keystoneWhy: Procs off your frequent W (Harsh Lesson) leaps and tentacle hits, giving you lane sustain against her poke. It's the dominant pick at 73.7% with a 57.1% measured win rate. Conqueror is a smaller-sample alternative (66.7% win rate) for players who want to commit fully to all-in trades instead.

summoners.why: Exhaust+Flash is the measured outlier at 87.5% win rate (42.1% pick) — Exhaust directly neutralizes her Ki Burst-into-empowered-autos burst window, and Flash lets you force the E lock across a gap she can't dash over. Flash+Teleport is more popular (47.4% pick) but converts far worse (33.3%).

playing.title: Never open with E
playing.detail: Throwing Test of Spirit first gives her Q (Broken Wings) or E (Valor) a way to dodge before the spirit connects, burning your 16-12s cooldown for nothing.

playing.title: Bait her dash first
playing.detail: Poke with autos until she commits Q or E to the trade. The instant either is on cooldown, land E — she has no gap-close or block left to escape the spirit link.

playing.title: Chain W after E lands
playing.detail: Harsh Lesson (4s cooldown) leaps onto the spirit-locked target and pulls nearby Tentacles into the fight, starting the champion-damage heal loop off your passive.

playing.title: Respect a loaded Ki Burst
playing.detail: Her W stuns nearby enemies on an 11-7s cooldown as she levels, and feeds Runic Blade-empowered autos right after. Don't facecheck melee range when it's clearly up.

playing.title: Fight over tentacle terrain
playing.detail: Your passive spawns Tentacles on nearby impassable terrain. Pull E trades toward walls or jungle edges so tentacles keep swinging and healing you through her dashes.

playing.title: Use R to answer her all-in
playing.detail: From level 6, Leap of Faith hits everyone nearby and spawns a Tentacle per champion hit. Use it the moment she commits her Q-W combo so the tentacle swarm outlasts her burst.

playing.title: Lean on Cleaver, not raw autos
playing.detail: Black Cleaver's armor shred (online by levels 9-13) is what lets your tentacle and auto damage keep pace with her empowered hits, since she has no sustain to out-heal it.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, boots, runes, and summoner picks above are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch via OP.GG; the cooldown numbers are from the live ability text, and the tactical reading — bait the dash, land E, chain W — is my own analysis of the kit, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: The victor of the engagement will depend on whether [E] lands successfully or not. We recommend not using abilities first as Riven can easily dodge them through (Q) or (E), but rather using [E] while kiting from a distance.
